notes: The thirteen live corpus statements plus the seven profile shapes, measured on KaveonDB alone on the three worker nodes: one warm-up then three timed executions, median reported. Targets are the done-when statements of docs/engineering/upper-hand-program.md; the Trino column is the 2026-09-15 time-to-answer pass on the same object.
